text:
Connor O'Brien: release coordination time — looking for go/no-go to enable the new regional failover automation flag in prod for a limited slice. This is the next stage after staging game day.

Proposed: enable `failover.orchestrator.enabled=true` in *prod* but scoped to:
- mode: `monitor-only` (no automatic routing/DNS actions)
- scope: hosted API only, `tier=dev/free`, `route=/v1/embeddings` (no chat)
- regions: us-east + us-west (no EU yet)
- max_canary_pct: 1%

If we’re all aligned, I’ll open the change + schedule a 60m window.
Need sign-offs from: SRE (Rafael), Smart Routing (Mina), Infra/Networking (Irene/Victor), Control Plane (Ethan). Also want Priya/Neha aware since this is “prod flag on”, even if monitor-only.

What I need in-thread:
1) explicit ✅/❌ from each owner
2) rollback plan confirmation
3) go/no-go checklist items we must have before flipping

ReleaseBot: Change gating checklist (prod flag enable)
- [ ] Feature flag default OFF; enable is reversible
- [ ] Blast radius documented (routes/tiers/regions)
- [ ] Runbook link added
- [ ] Dashboards/alerts ready + on-call aware
- [ ] Rollback steps tested in staging
- [ ] Infra changes reviewed/applied (if any)
- [ ] Approvals captured in-thread

Rafael Mendes: ✅ from SRE with conditions:
- monitor-only is fine
- must have the state machine hard-disabled from taking action unless manually approved (i.e. no “oops it failed over”) — want an explicit `action_gate=manual` in config
- paging: no new pages from monitor-only metrics unless they’re behind a separate alert route (don’t spam primary on-call)

Also please link the runbook section on “disable + verify” so on-call knows the kill switch.

Miles Thornton: +1. In this stage, orchestrator should only emit state transition events (degraded/failed) + recommended action into #incidents, but no writes to routing policy store.

Rollback plan (if we see unexpected behavior/noise):
1) flip flag OFF in LaunchDarkly (`failover.orchestrator.enabled=false`)
2) verify orchestrator reports `disabled` in `/admin/failover/status`
3) confirm no policy writes in audit log for the window
4) if anything did write (shouldn’t), revert routing policy version to last good (we have the pinned hash in the change doc)

Mina Haddad: ✅ routing sign-off *if* scoping is enforced server-side (not just “we promise”).
Questions:
- how are you scoping to `/v1/embeddings` and `tier=dev/free`? via policy tags or request attributes?
- are we including Dedicated traffic at all? (please no)

If you can paste the exact scope config, I’m good.

Ethan Park: ✅ control plane sign-off. We can enforce scope using routing attributes (route_id + customer_tier). The flag config we’re using is read by the control plane and passed to the orchestrator as an allowlist; not just UI.

I’ll also confirm RBAC: only `oncall-sre` + `release-eng` can toggle the flag, and only `oncall-sre` can hit `/admin/failover/override`.

Benji Okafor: re: “action_gate=manual” — yep, that exists. For this rollout stage:
- `mode=monitor_only`
- `action_gate=manual`
- `write_enabled=false`

So even if someone fat-fingers a transition, it won’t touch routing.

Also, we have a hold-down timer set in config but it shouldn’t matter for monitor-only. (Worth calling out: it’s 30m right now.)

Aisha Bello: ✅ from SLO/alerts side with one request:
- please route any new alerts from the failover dashboards to `#eng-sre-alerts-lowprio` for the first 48h

Dashboards are up for:
- region health composite signal
- orchestrator state transitions (even in monitor-only)
- error budget burn overlays

I’ll post links in the change doc once it’s opened.

Irene Choi: Infra ✅ with caveats.
- Confirm we are NOT applying any DNS/edge routing Terraform as part of this change.
- If any synthetic probes are being enabled/increased, please coordinate with Networking so we don’t create a self-inflicted incident.

If this is purely “prod flag on, no writes”, I’m good.

Victor Alvarez: Networking ✅ assuming no DNS record changes. The TTL strategy work is in progress but not tied to this flag enable.

One note: synthetic network probes from us-east -> us-west were a little noisy last week. If you’re using those as part of the composite signal, we should keep them as “informational” and not page.

Miles Thornton: good call — composite signal weights network probe loss as *one input*; it doesn’t gate anything in monitor-only and won’t page. We’ll treat it as a “yellow flag” until we tune.

Mina Haddad: scope question: can we do allowlist like:
- routes: `[embeddings_v1]`
- tiers: `[dev, free]`
- regions: `[use1, usw2]`
- max_pct: `1`

And explicit `dedicated=false`?

Ethan Park: yes. Here’s the exact config blob we can attach to the change ticket:
```
failover_orchestrator:
  enabled: true
  mode: monitor_only
  action_gate: manual
  write_enabled: false
  scope:
    deployment_modes: [hosted]
    customer_tiers: [dev, free]
    routes: [embeddings_v1]
    regions: [use1, usw2]
    max_canary_pct: 1
```

Connor O'Brien: perfect. I’ll paste that into the change.

Priya Natarajan: ✅ platform leadership OK with this stage. Conditions:
- keep it monitor-only
- clear owner on call for the window (Rafael or delegate)
- if metrics are noisy, revert fast and file follow-ups rather than “let it ride”

Neha Kapoor: 👍 agree w/ Priya. Make sure comms are ready internally (at least #announcements heads-up) even though this is low risk.

Rafael Mendes: I can be primary for the window. Please schedule during business hours PT.

Connor O'Brien: awesome. Proposed window: Thu 10:00–11:00 PT.

Go/no-go checklist I’ll enforce before the flip:
- runbook link (Automated Region Failover Runbook → “Disable / monitor-only / verify no writes”)
- dashboards links from Aisha
- RBAC confirmed by Ethan
- no Terraform applies (Irene/Victor confirmed)
- revert steps documented + tested in staging (Miles/Benji confirmed)

If anything blocks, we’ll push. Otherwise I’ll open the change and tag everyone for final ✅ day-of.

Benji Okafor: :thumbsup: I’ll be around for the first 15 min after enable in case the config parser yells.

Aisha Bello: :thumbsup: I’ll watch burn-rate + state transitions.

Irene Choi: :thumbsup: (no infra changes on my side)

Connor O'Brien: cool — calling this GO pending day-of checks. I’ll drop the change ticket link here once it’s created.
